sources.title: Z.ai (Zhipu AI) Open Models: Model List and Licenses
sources.snippet: Z.ai (Zhipu AI) is a Chinese AI company. According to the card of its zai-org organization on Hugging Face, it builds the ChatGLM (GLM) family of language models, develops LLMs as agents, and releases related training and inference techniques.
